title: Kevin O'Connell: Kyler Murray feels "pretty good," we'll take it a day at a time

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin O'Connell: Kyler Murray feels "pretty good," we'll take it a day at a time
sources.description: Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray was knocked out of Sunday's game on the team's third offensive possession and head coach Kevin O'Connell gave an update on his condition at a Monday press conference.
